atlas:summary.identify: Map with one country highlighted. Its name is hidden until you answer.
atlas:summary.identify__note: Screen-reader label for the globe on a 'Which country is this?' question, BEFORE answering. Must never name the country.
atlas:summary.identifyRevealed__note: Screen-reader label for the globe after a 'Which country is this?' question is answered. {country} is the correct country.
atlas:summary.identifyWrong: Map showing {country}, highlighted, and {chosen}, the country you picked.
atlas:summary.identifyWrong__note: After a wrong answer to 'Which country is this?': both countries are drawn. {country} is the right one, {chosen} the learner's pick. Calm, no blame.
atlas:summary.country__note: Screen-reader label for the globe beside a question that already names the country.
atlas:summary.capitalHidden: Map of {country}, highlighted. Its capital is shown after you answer.
atlas:summary.capitalHidden__note: Before answering 'What is the capital of X?'. Must never name the capital.
atlas:summary.capitalPinned: Map of {country}, with its capital, {capital}, pinned.
atlas:summary.capitalPinned__note: After answering a capital question, when the capital has a verified location on the map.
atlas:summary.capitalUnpinned__note: After answering a capital question when the capital has no verified map location, so no pin is drawn. States the fact only.
atlas:summary.world__note: Screen-reader label for the Explore globe with nothing selected.
atlas:summary.exploreSelected: Globe showing {country}, with its capital, {capital}, pinned.
atlas:summary.exploreSelected__note: Explore globe with a country selected and its capital pinned.
atlas:control.recenter__note: Icon button that turns the globe back to the selected country. Screen-reader label.
atlas:control.zoomIn__note: Icon button on the globe. Screen-reader label.
atlas:control.zoomOut__note: Icon button on the globe. Screen-reader label.
atlas:state.loading__note: Shown inside the globe while its textures load. Max 24 characters.
atlas:fallback.capital__note: Under the flat map after a capital question, when the 3D globe is unavailable. {capital} is the city name.
atlas:explore.capital__note: Label before the capital's name on the Explore country card. Max 12 characters.
atlas:explore.open__note: Button on the Explore country card that opens the country's page, where its lessons are. Max 24 characters plus the name.
atlas:explore.close__note: Icon button that closes the Explore country card. Screen-reader label.
atlas:explore.all__note: Region filter chip that shows every continent. Max 10 characters.
atlas:explore.browse__note: Disclosure that expands or collapses the accessible country list. {count} is the number of countries in the current region filter, or all countries when unfiltered.
atlas:explore.listLabel__note: Screen-reader name of the list that mirrors the globe, for anyone who cannot use the map by touch.
atlas:summary.locate: Map of {region}. Find the country the question names, and tap it.
atlas:summary.locate__note: Screen-reader label for the globe in a map quiz, BEFORE answering. {region} is a continent name (explore:region.*). Must never name the country being asked for.
atlas:drill.start__note: Button under the Explore globe when a continent chip is selected. Starts a map quiz over that continent. {region} is explore:region.* ("Europe"). Max 32 characters.
atlas:drill.hint: A map quiz: each question names a country, and you tap it on the map.
atlas:drill.hint__note: Screen-reader hint for atlas:drill.start: what the button starts.
atlas:summary.locateRetry: Map of {region}. {chosen} is marked; find the country the question names, and tap it.
atlas:summary.locateRetry__note: Screen-reader label for the map quiz globe after a wrong tap, while the learner tries again. {chosen} is the country they tapped. Must never name the country being asked for.
